171:t_1:90.en:
$$ラクス$$
「$$キラ$$... Do you know of the person called the progenitor of the Coordinators?」

171:t_1:91.en:
$$キラ$$
「You mean 《$$ジョージ・グレン$$》?」

171:t_1:92.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Yes. ...Then do you know why the $$コーディネイター$$s were born?」

171:t_1:93.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$ジョージ・グレン$$ said... that it was so they would become mediators, a bridge between humanity and the new humanity that would one day be born.」

171:t_1:94.en:
$$ラクス$$
「He personally may well have believed that.」

171:t_1:95.en:
$$ラクス$$
「But the truth was something else entirely.」

171:t_1:97.en:
$$ラクス$$
「To begin with, do you know what the 'new humanity' he spoke of actually is?」

171:t_1:98.en:
$$キラ$$
「...Something like the $$ニュータイプ$$ of the $$宇宙世紀$$, or the $$イノベイター$$s of the $$ＡＤＷ$$?」

171:t_1:99.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Those beings have been almost entirely proven to exist. But in our world, the $$コズミック・イラ$$, no such humanity has been confirmed yet.」

171:t_1:100.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Only the theory is said to have been proposed, and it seems fair to say that the research has almost come to a halt at present.」

171:t_1:101.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Why do you think that is?」

171:t_1:103.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Perhaps such people had already been confirmed somewhere we knew nothing about...」

171:t_1:105.en:
$$ラクス$$
「They were probably secretly erased from existence...」

171:t_1:106.en:
$$ラクス$$
「By the hands of our world's $$クロノ$$.」

171:t_1:108.en:
$$ラクス$$
「What $$クロノ$$ fears is the birth of a new humanity in space.」

171:t_1:109.en:
$$ラクス$$
「That is why, in our world, they used 《$$ロゴス$$》 and its subordinate organization 《$$ブルーコスモス$$》 to attack the $$コーディネイター$$s.」

171:t_1:110.en:
$$キラ$$
「Wait, $$ラクス$$...! Are you saying the $$コーディネイター$$s are that new humanity?!」

171:t_1:111.en:
$$キラ$$
「Weren't the $$コーディネイター$$s supposed to be the link between that new humanity and humanity?!」

171:t_1:112.en:
$$ラクス$$
「...The $$コーディネイター$$s are beings born from a project to artificially bring about a new humanity...」

171:t_1:113.en:
$$ラクス$$
「At the same time, they are also beings meant to protect the new humanity that will one day be born from $$クロノ$$.」

171:t_1:115.en:
$$ラクス$$
「The $$コーディネイター$$s... were created by the $$クロノ$$ Reformists, who branched off from $$クロノ$$.」

171:t_1:116.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$ラクス$$...! What are you saying?!」

171:t_1:117.en:
$$ラクス$$
「...All of this is... the truth...」

171:t_1:119.en:
$$ラクス$$
「To change the course toward war that surrounds $$プラント$$, I was thinking of rallying the strength of the people known as the $$クライン$$ Faction.」

171:t_1:120.en:
$$ラクス$$
「And in the process, I found a memoir that Father had left for me.」

171:t_1:121.en:
$$キラ$$
「Your father... Chairman $$シーゲル・クライン$$...」

171:t_1:122.en:
$$ラクス$$
「It recorded what I just told you.」

171:t_1:123.en:
$$ラクス$$
「And then I learned... that my family, the $$クライン$$ family, is a lineage of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」

171:t_1:125.en:
$$ラクス$$
「The important figures at the founding of $$プラント$$ were probably people under the influence of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」

171:t_1:126.en:
$$ラクス$$
「That some of them regarded the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives... in other words, the $$ナチュラル$$s living on Earth, as potential enemies was also because of this fact.」

171:t_1:127.en:
$$キラ$$
「The war between $$ナチュラル$$s and $$コーディネイター$$s was caused by the internal split of $$クロノ$$...」

171:t_1:128.en:
$$ラクス$$
「And amid that, the people of the $$クライン$$ Faction, beginning with Father, were searching for a peaceful solution...」

171:t_1:129.en:
$$ラクス$$
「But now, in the atmosphere heading toward war, the $$クライン$$ Faction too has returned to its original ideals and resolved to fight the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives.」

171:t_1:130.en:
$$ラクス$$
「And they are joining hands with others who have learned the truth of the past, and are trying to lead $$プラント$$ into war.」

171:t_1:131.en:
$$キラ$$
「So you mean the hidden facts have been revealed to many people only now...?」

171:t_1:132.en:
$$ラクス$$
「How that came about is not clear, but...」

171:t_1:133.en:
$$キラ$$
「But $$クロノ$$'s power was lost in the $$時獄戦役$$...! And with the $$サイデリアル$$ here now, for Earthlings to fight each other...!」

171:t_1:134.en:
$$ラクス$$
「They will go along with $$フル・フロンタル$$'s words and declare that they themselves are the rightful heirs of Earth's humanity.」

171:t_1:135.en:
$$ラクス$$
「By overthrowing the $$地球連邦$$... the $$ナチュラル$$s...」

171:t_1:136.en:
$n
「$$キラ$$! Armed people are gathering around the Council Hall!」

171:t_1:137.en:
$$キラ$$
「We're getting out of here, $$ラクス$$!」

171:t_1:140.en:
$$ラクス$$
「As a member of the $$クライン$$ family, there is something I must do...」

171:t_1:141.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「$$ラクス$$, we have come to escort you.」

171:t_1:145.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「I see... So $$ラクス$$ was meeting him here to draw him into our forces.」

171:t_1:151.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「$$キラ・ヤマト$$...! You too will fulfill your mission as a $$コーディネイター$$!」

171:t_1:152.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「It is your power as the Super $$コーディネイター$$ that we need for the fight against the $$ナチュラル$$s.」

171:t_1:154.en:
$n
「$$キラ$$! Let's get out of here!」

171:t_1:157.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「Now come, $$キラ・ヤマト$$.」

171:t_1:161.en:
$$シン$$
「$n! I'm leaving $$キラ$$ to you!」

171:t_1:163.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「$$キラ・ヤマト$$ must become, as the symbol of the $$コーディネイター$$s, the power to annihilate the $$ナチュラル$$s!」

171:t_1:164.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「The people of space will become the true Earthlings! As the new humanity to lead the next age!」

171:t_1:167.en:
$$アスラン$$
「If this goes on, $$プラント$$ will...! It will head straight for ruin!」
